newsitem.title: USA: State Street to acquire Fleet unit.
newsitem.headline: State Street to acquire Fleet unit.

text.p: State Street Boston Corp said on Tuesday that it has agreed to acquire the corporate trust business of Fleet Financial Group Inc for undisclosed terms.
Fleet is trustee and paying agent for 6,300 corporate trust issues representing approximately $96 billion of outstanding bonds, State Street said.
The acquisition is expected to be finalized, subject to regulatory approvals, during the second quarter of 1997, State Street said.
With this acquisition, State Street will become trustee and paying agent for more than $400 billion of outstanding bonds, it said.
